name: Pop's Cafe Hanceville
summary: Pop's Cafe Hanceville is a 1950s style diner with chrome counters and checkered floors. Regulars order fluffy pancakes and everyday meatloaf, and cakes are baked fresh when the kitchen has them ready.
hours: Monday to Friday 7 AM to 2 PM; Sunday 11 AM to 3 PM; check Facebook for Saturday hours

name: Country Wok
summary: Country Wok on Bangor Avenue serves Chinese American favorites plus newer plates like ramen, Japanese hot dogs, Hong Kong wontons and a matcha cannoli. Owner Kenny Lee keeps the menu focused and sources ingredients locally. Open Tuesday to Saturday 11 AM to 7 PM.
hours: Tuesday to Saturday 11 AM to 7 PM; closed Sunday and Monday

name: Hanceville Drug Co Soda Fountain
summary: This soda fountain sits inside a pharmacy that has served Hanceville since 1916. Order a scoop, a sundae, a float, a shake or the famous cherry ice. Bring the kids.
hours: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5:30 PM; Saturday 8 AM to 2 PM; closed Sunday

name: Dodge City Restaurant
summary: You'll find it inside the Dodge City Travel Center. Locals and truck drivers both eat here, and the fried cheeseburger has a loyal following.

name: Meatloaf Every Day at Pop's
summary: Pop's Cafe has meatloaf every day. Chicken and dumplings, dressing and vegetable soup rotate through the week, and you can call ahead to ask for a dish.

name: Azul Tequila Mexican Cantina
summary: Azul Tequila Mexican Cantina on Main Street plates tacos, fajitas and classic Mexican American favorites for dine in or takeout from late morning through evening.

name: Cafe Tula Taquería
summary: Cafe Tula Taquería on Commercial Street serves tacos, burritos and daily Mexican plates for dine in or pickup. Tamales are available by phone or in person order ahead of Mud Creek Festival on Nov. 7.
hours_source: https://www.restauranteamexicana.com/mexican-restaurants-near-me/cafe-tula-taqueria (checked Nov. 6, 2026); Facebook Page open status checked
hours: Monday 11 AM to 2 PM; Tuesday to Saturday 11 AM to 8 PM; closed Sunday

name: Reyes Pizza
summary: Reyes Pizza on Main Street is a hometown stop for pies, calzones and homemade sides. Call ahead when the family wants pickup before the evening rush.
hours: Monday to Saturday 11 AM to 8 PM; closed Sunday

name: HanceVegas Coffee Shop
summary: HanceVegas Coffee Shop and Pub on Commercial Street pours coffee, espresso drinks and cafe fare Tuesday through Saturday. The shop closes Mondays and Sundays.
hours_source: https://www.restaurants10.com/US/Hanceville/102878649521581/Hance-Vegas (checked Nov. 6, 2026); business posts confirm Tuesday to Saturday schedule
hours: Tuesday to Saturday 7 AM to 6 PM; closed Sunday and Monday

name: Jack's
summary: Jack's on Styles Street serves Southern breakfast biscuits, burgers and shakes with dine in, drive thru and mobile ordering. It opens early for breakfast every day.
hours: Monday to Thursday 4 AM to 10 PM; Friday and Saturday 4 AM to 11 PM; Sunday 5 AM to 10 PM

name: McDonald's
summary: Quick meals on Main Street when the family is in a hurry.

name: Subway
summary: Subs made to order on Main Street.

name: Taco Bell
summary: Tacos and burritos on Main Street.
